hits.text: --- title: Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service source_url: https://web.erl2.gov.lk/ secondary_url: https://www.gov.lk/services/erl/es/erl/view/index.action source_org: Department of Motor Traffic / Provincial Councils, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service (eRL) ## English The eRL service is the official online portal for vehicle revenue licence renewal in Sri Lanka. The supported vehicle categories include Motor Cars, Motor Cycles, Dual Purpose Vehicles, Land Vehicles, Three Wheelers, and other classes maintained by the Department of Motor Traffic.

How the service works: - First-time users sign up on web.erl2.gov.lk before logging in. - The user enters the vehicle number and the last 6 digits of the chassis number to confirm ownership. - A valid Insurance Certificate is required. A Vehicle Emission Test Certificate is required for vehicle categories where it applies. - The system accepts credit and debit card payments only. After payment confirmation, a temporary printable licence valid for 14 days is sent by email.

The Call Centre is operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with 21 call operators. During floods and other declared disasters, the DMC issues Situation Reports through its public-facing reports portal. Citizens are advised to check the DMC site for the current bulletin before relying on older publications. General flood safety advice issued by DMC and partner agencies: - Do not wade through flowing water deeper than ankle depth on foot.

- Store at least three days of drinking water per family member, and charge mobile phones and power banks once a warning is issued. - Keep important documents in a waterproof container, and pack a small emergency kit (medication, identification copies, torch, first-aid). - The eye of the cyclone passing overhead can create a deceptive calm of about 20 to 30 minutes before high winds resume from the opposite direction. Do not go outside during this calm. During cyclone preparedness in coastal districts, households are advised to: - Secure loose objects around the home and identify the nearest safe building or evacuation shelter.

Early warning signs that require immediate action include: - new cracks in walls, floors, or the ground, - doors or windows that suddenly start sticking, - tilted trees or fences, - water seeping from unusual locations on a slope. If severe landslide signs are observed, the public should promptly inform the relevant authorities and evacuate to a safer place to avoid the risks.

- Yellow (Level 1) warning: when rainfall in the previous 24 hours exceeds 75 mm, the public should be aware of the possibility of landslides, slope failures, rock falls, cut-slope failure, and ground subsidence, and should be prepared to evacuate to a safe location if necessary. query: How much drinking water should I store per family member before a cyclone?

hits.text: - Store at least three days of drinking water per family member, and charge mobile phones and power banks once a warning is issued. - Keep important documents in a waterproof container, and pack a small emergency kit (medication, identification copies, torch, first-aid). During the cyclone passage: - Stay indoors. Move to an interior room away from windows.

- Vehicles should not be driven through flooded roads; even six inches of fast-flowing water can sweep a car off the road. - After flood waters recede, drinking water from open wells should be boiled for at least one minute or treated with chlorine tablets, because standing flood water often contains sewage and chemical runoff. ## සිංහල (summary) ආපදා කළමනාකරණ මධ්යස්ථානයේ (DMC) අවස්ථානුකූල දුරකථන අංකය වන 117 අංකය දින 24 කල් සහ සතියේ දින 7 ම සක්රීය වේ.

- The eye of the cyclone passing overhead can create a deceptive calm of about 20 to 30 minutes before high winds resume from the opposite direction. Do not go outside during this calm. After the cyclone has passed, watch for downed power lines, broken glass, and structurally damaged buildings. Downed lines should be reported to the Ceylon Electricity Board. ## සිංහල (summary) කාලගුණ විද්යා දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව (Department of Meteorology) සුළි කුණාටු හා දරුණු කාලගුණ ඇඟවීම් නිකුත් කරයි.
